name: Anglo-Iranian Oil Company (AIOC)
operational_role: Exclusive concessionaire operating Iran's oil extraction and the Abadan refinery under highly unfavorable royalty agreements for Iran.
documented_activities: Following the 1951 nationalization of Iranian oil by Prime Minister Mohammad Mosaddegh, AIOC enforced a worldwide boycott of Iranian crude, seized foreign tankers carrying Iranian oil, and actively lobbied the British and US governments for covert political and military intervention to overthrow Mosaddegh.
documented_consequences: Total economic paralysis in Iran resulting from the oil embargo, which deepened social unrest and created economic pretexts utilized by the CIA and MI6 to orchestrate the August 1953 coup.
